definitions.gloss: suddenly, all of a sudden, without warning
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening abruptly and unexpectedly. A formal, written-style adverb often found in news reports, novels, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {突如|とつじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突如|とつじょ}⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A power outage occurred suddenly during the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{突如|とつじょ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}し→消す：00528_kesu⟧、⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなく→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He suddenly disappeared, and after that no one could reach him.

notes:
USAGE:
{突如|とつじょ} is more formal and literary than ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ (suddenly). It often appears with the particle ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ as {突如|とつじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧, which adds a slightly more dramatic tone. In casual speech, ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ or ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧ are preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {突如|とつじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: suddenly (emphatic form)
- {突如|とつじょ}⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: to appear suddenly
- {突如|とつじょ}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to vanish suddenly
- {突如|とつじょ}⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to break out suddenly

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ is the standard, all-purpose word for "suddenly" used in both speech and writing. ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧ is casual and emphasizes abruptness. {突如|とつじょ} is the most formal of the three and is mainly found in written or news-style Japanese.
